description.value: An Esso Circle K combination gas station and convenience store operating around the clock on First Avenue in Chilliwack. The station offers multiple fuel grades including premium gasoline and features an air tower, making it a practical stop for topping up supplies or adjusting tire pressure. Touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack will find it a reliable resupply point in the city centre.
